analysis:
This PR modifies only docs/architecture/inference.md, with no code, key-handling, protocol, or authorization changes. Head edits (per file_changes ranges): a new GLM5Next implementation-boundary section (head lines ~71-313), MiMo table rows (905-913), and a few smaller edits (931, 942-962, 1228-1253, 1501-1508). Only the first ~395 head lines and the base 831-1204 excerpts were supplied, so the later head edits were not examined.

Security-relevant doc claims I saw:
- Line 61: a refused SSD store's typed reason reaches the bridge for local /metrics only. This is a diagnostic disclosure claim, not an exposure to consumers or the coordinator.
- Lines 269-279: a retained GLM fault quarantines GLM work only and charges unpublished bytes into every fleet KV budget.
- Lines 123-128: the GLM serving path is fail-closed when MTP is not active.
- Lines 309-313: the GLM prompt template is pinned by SHA-256 and any other template is refused.
- Lines 105-114: the identity chain is catalog pin -> revision receipt -> per-file manifest hash.
- MiMo prefix rows keep encrypted SSD reuse, which maps to T-041.

These statements do not contradict T-041 as supplied: HMAC lookup tags, the 30-minute TTL, and coordinator-authored cacheSalt are unchanged. Nothing here weakens trust-boundary assumptions. Claims about GLM media handling and ownership are documentation of source I could not see, so the next pass should not treat them as verified.

Coverage limit: the head text is truncated at line 395. The later head edits were not reviewed, and the patch excerpt is incomplete.
